newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY BEAT POLAND 3-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY BEAT POLAND 3-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Italy beat Poland 3-0 in a European group two World Cup qualifier on Wednesday.
Scorers - Roberto Di Matteo 23, Paolo Maldini 37, Roberto Baggio 63

Italy - 1-Angelo Peruzzi; 2-Ciro Ferrara (13-Christian Panucci 85), 7-Angelo Di Livio, 6-Alessandro Costacurta, 5-Fabio Cannavaro, 3-Paolo Maldini, 8-Roberto Di Matteo, 10-Demetrio Albertini, 4-Dino Baggio (15-Diego Fuser 85), 11-Gianfranco Zola (18-Roberto Baggio 51), 9-Fabrizio Ravanelli.

Poland - 1-Andrzej Wozniak; 2-Pawel Skrzypek, 3-Jacek Zielinski, 4-Pawel Wojtala, 5-Tomasz Waldoch (16-Slawomir Mayak 46), 6-Marek Citko, 7-Radoslaw Kaluzny, 8-Henryk Baluszynski (15-Tomasz Hajto 66), 9-Cezary Kucharski (17-Krzysztof Warzycha 46), 10-Piotr Nowak, 11-Adam Ledwon.
